sqlquery.from: (SELECT ti.id,date_trunc('month', t.journaldate) as date, SUM(CASE WHEN a.accountcode='0100' THEN COALESCE(ti.debit, 0) - COALESCE(ti.credit, 0) END) as income, SUM(CASE WHEN a.accountcode='2108' THEN COALESCE(ti.debit, 0) - COALESCE(ti.credit, 0) END) as expense from "$".transactionItem ti LEFT JOIN "$".transaction t ON t.id = ti.transactionid JOIN "$".account a ON a.id = ti.accountid WHERE (t.journaldate BETWEEN date_trunc('year', now()) AND now()) group by date_trunc('month', t.journaldate),ti.id order by date) t
